reviewNotes: HOLD. Current pricing, roaming and identity flow are well documented, but the route remains resident-document/address gated for acquisition and has a scheduled 2026-12-01 tariff change. Preserve as negative/conditional backstage knowledge; no publication change.

events.outcome: Current 30GB JPY2,970/month remains valid through 2026-11-30; official ahamo materials schedule a tiered JPY3,135/40GB entry plan from 2026-12-01.

data.acquisitionSummary: Current ahamo is JPY2,970/month for 30GB through 2026-11-30 with no application fee. Foreign-national online identity verification uses a residence card whose name/address must match the application; the current online flow does not provide a passport-only nonresident path.

keep.action: Maintain the monthly ahamo subscription. There is no verified idle/PAYG number-parking mode.

data.chinaActivation: New nonresident activation from mainland China is not established. Existing ahamo lines support overseas voice/SMS in more than 200 countries/regions, but subscriber eligibility still depends on the Japan identity/address path.
data.kyc: Foreign-national applicants are directed to use a residence card; application name/address must match the identity document. Since 2026-03-12 online verification is IC/JPKI-based, and some second-generation residence-card variants issued from 2026-06-14 are not accepted in the online flow.
data.payment: Monthly payment supports credit card or bank-account transfer. Overseas-issued card acceptance is not established by current official evidence.
data.roamingSms: Official ahamo support states voice and SMS are available in more than 200 countries/regions. Service-specific OTP success in mainland China is not separately verified.
data.holdReason: Resident-document/address acquisition constraints make this unsuitable as a general nonresident route, and the current JPY2,970/30GB profile is scheduled to change on 2026-12-01 to a JPY3,135/40GB entry tier.
data.tariffSummary: Current through 2026-11-30: 30GB JPY2,970/month. From 2026-12-01: tiered 40GB JPY3,135 / 60GB JPY4,125 / 120GB JPY5,115.
guideSteps: Treat JPY2,970/month as a time-bounded current price only through 2026-11-30.
Do not present passport-only/nonresident remote signup as supported.
Reverify price and overseas behavior on or after 2026-12-01 before changing status.
